blocks.text: LET'S RECAP. BY AUGUST 1941, THE FBI|HAS THE PEARL HARBOR QUESTIONNAIRE|AND POPOV'S WARNING ABOUT TARANTO.|FOUR MONTHS BEFORE THE ATTACK.
AND NOBODY WARNS THE NAVY|IN HAWAII. NEGLIGENCE?|RIVALRY BETWEEN AGENCIES?|OR HOOVER'S CONTEMPT FOR POPOV?
NO HISTORIAN HAS PROVED|ANYONE MEANT TO LET IT|HAPPEN. AND THE QUESTIONNAIRE|GAVE NEITHER A DATE|NOR AN ATTACK.
I'M NOT SAYING ANYONE WANTED|THE DISASTER. I'M SAYING NOBODY|LISTENED TO THE WARNING, BECAUSE|IT CAME FROM A PLAYBOY.
